desc.zh: 从逐段相加到前缀差，用归并的有序两半数出合法区间。
desc.en: Derive prefix differences and count valid pairs across sorted halves.

complexity: O(n log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Prefix differences
concepts.description: Convert a contiguous sum into a difference of two prefix totals.

concepts.name: Cross-half range counting
concepts.description: Preserve index order by splitting before sorting; count with two monotone boundaries.
